description.en: Model-facing tools that create a workspace conversation, send a prompt into it, wait for the turn to finish, and read the reply, so a lead agent can dispatch work into real standalone sessions instead of subagents.
description.zh: 给主代理用的会话派发工具：新建工作区会话、把指令发进去、等这一轮结束、读它的回复，把子任务放进真正独立的主会话里跑，而不是子代理。
